notes.title: 【Lewd Formosa】New Game release
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/a5834554502bef2cbc952fe97c4858a3388d96fb.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528560/

The game is a simulation game mainly with the fox demon Vivi. You will spend 30 days together.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/d94f30052f0d5a0dcc98cde17f5e7b285ed5b6dd.png

Four actions can be carried out with the fox demon Vivi in a day.
Action commands include "Talk", "Interact", "Go out" and "H".

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/e187459784bf5c0090b5f38ed914e56c4695c52b.jpg

Take her to various unique places to play and increase the positive feelings toward each other.
Talk with her to understand her past and uncover her secrets…

As the days pass by, you can unlock more special plot events with Vivi.
There are also many different Hentai events in the game. You can do various positions with Vivi.

But remember, living with a demon means you might see other demons along the way...

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/946396d49a85a50464dc8eefff3952f57fc190bb.png

notes.title: Update Version 1.16
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33653065/cc084ad66dfde10a4f94fe983a5c67b149b459e7.png

1.16 Update

 Added Spanish and Korean language support.
 Fixed 1.14 bug where game would crash at launch.
 Having a savegame unlocks the staff credits, which you can view directly from the main menu.


Status Update
After Taipei Game Show, I found time to come back to "Story of Eve". Thank you for waiting patiently and sorry for making everyone go back to 1.13. I've fixed all the issues associated with 1.14! Haha!

Steam Cards will take a while longer. Our artist is still busy with her day job so we're waiting on her to spare some time for the cards. It's also been challenging to come up with SFW content for the cards, but despite all that she has made some progress!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33653065/834fddf63eefb7545107f58528cdc39610b118ca.jpg

I'm thinking of putting together unreleased CGs and story content into a new simple mini-game. The main artist Sayika is occupied with commissions in the forseeable future so making this mini-game would be the quickest way to deliver a little story-related update. I'm open to suggestions if anybody has any good ideas.

Happy Lunar New Year everyone!

notes.title: Update Version 1.14
notes.notes:
1.14 patch notes:
-fixed text errors in tentacle scene

Hi all, it's been a while!
For Spanish-speaking players, you may have noticed that our steam page now supports Spanish. A fan has reached out to me about translating the game into Spanish and I'm currently considering it. If you'd like to translate this game to another language, please add me on Steam and message me.

I know a lot of you have asked about Steam Cards and we're back to work on it. Our UI artist had some family business to attend to so the project was on hiatus. Now that she's back, we can continue working on those cards. Furthermore, our main artist has returned as well so we'll also be able to add new outfits and stories that didn't make it to the release.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33653065/f4c4ab187f109eaf5489d1102d0ab949265aa594.jpg

We just finished exhibiting our upcoming game at a convention in Taipei.
If you'd like to learn more about it, please follow me on Twitter: https://twitter.com/smallsqurriel

notes.title: Update Version 1.13
notes.notes:
Thank you to all the passionate players for your comments and suggestions. I've further improved the English dialogue by fixing typos and (hopefully) making things sound better.

Version 1.13 Changelog
- Edited English localization
- Fixed incorrect punctuation being displayed
- Changed the Achievement "Outfit Collector" to "First Save" since it was being triggered on the first save.

Some players want to see more CGs and story added to the game. Because the game is doing pretty well, I'm considering adding some more story content so players can experience more. I'll try my best to make something happen but because the artist Sakiya is busy for the rest of the year, it might not happen that quickly.

About trading cards, I plan to make some and release in about two weeks.
What card designs/images do you want to see?

Thanks

notes.title: Update Version 1.12
notes.notes:
In the bit of chaos after the release, I've updated the game!

Version 1.12 Changelog
- Fixed tutorial skipping
- Fixed some achievements triggering incorrectly
- Edited English localization

I've noticed the issue that some regions can't access the game or achievements. This is because I didn't fully understand Steam's system. I have now adjusted the global pricing issue and ticked the right boxes for the achievements. Everything should be fixed, and I hope everyone can now properly access the game.

I've also been asked about Steam Trading Cards, and I apologize because I don't have the time to create them. I am currently working on the second SmallSqurriel game.

Thanks for playing the game and feel free to ask me any questions.
